title: fix(console): Audit Log's action filter offers sys_audit_log.action's declared options (objectui#13175)
body:
Fixes #13175

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Audit Log's Action filter (`apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`) now offers the declared options of `sys_audit_log.action`, read from the `sys_audit_log` object document the console's metadata already serves. The hand-kept `ACTION_OPTIONS` list is deleted.

- `actionFilterOptionsOf` (`apps/console/src/pages/system/auditLogActions.ts`) reads `fields.action.options` from that document and returns each declared option in declared order, valued by its stored value and labelled as declared. An option with no value is skipped (a select item cannot carry an empty value); a blank label shows the value.
- The page reads the document from `useMetadata().objects`, the same served registry the presets (objectui#12667) and the Object filter (objectui#13165) read. No new request and no new endpoint.
- The query is unchanged: the chosen value is still sent as an exact `action` match in `$filter` to `GET /api/v1/data/sys_audit_log`. "All actions" is still the unfiltered state.
- The badge tones stay as a lookup, now module-private behind `actionBadgeVariant`. An action with no local tone gets the neutral `outline` badge, as it did before. The helper also answers `outline` for an action spelled like an `Object.prototype` member (`constructor`), which the old inline index read would have handed to the badge as a function.
- While the object metadata has not loaded, or when the console is not served `sys_audit_log`, the filter offers only "All actions", never a list of its own.

The Object filter's code is untouched. Its test file's fixture now also serves `sys_audit_log`, as a real console does, because its "the action filter joins the object filter" case picks `update`, which must now be declared. That adds "Audit Log (sys_audit_log)" to the object options that case lists.

## The hypotheses, measured on `origin/main` `3cec090`

- **H1, the hand-kept list: confirmed.** `auditLogActions.ts` declared `ACTION_OPTIONS` as a literal list of seven values, and the page mapped it into the Action select's items.
- **H2, the metadata is already on the page: confirmed.** The page reads `useMetadata().objects`. `MetadataProvider` fills it from `meta.getItems('object')`, the full object documents (it normalises field reference keys on them at ingestion), so `fields.action.options` is in hand. objectstack `main` `c3a8e07b6` declares the field with `Field.select` over a list of eleven strings, which serves each option as a label equal to its value. `read`, `platform_admin_standing_change`, `login_failed` and `account_locked` are among them.
- **H3, badge styling: confirmed, already neutral.** Both badge sites already fell back to `outline` for an unmapped action. No row was hidden and no option dropped by the badge path.
- **H4, the precedent: read.** objectui#13165 (`c209c93`) moved the Object filter onto the served objects with the same read; this change follows it.

## Tests (head `bf7e959`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage apps/console/src/pages/system/auditLogActions --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files  6 passed (6)`, `Tests  39 passed (39)`, exit 0.
  - `auditLogActions.test.ts` (rewritten): given the server's eleven declared options, the filter offers exactly those eleven in declared order; given two declared options it offers those two only (`create` is absent, `nightly_purge`, a value no code names, is offered); labels are the declared ones; no declared options offers nothing; the module exports no array; `actionBadgeVariant` keeps the local tones and answers `outline` for every other action.
  - `AuditLogPage.actionFilter-13175.test.tsx` (new): the select offers "All actions" then every declared label in declared order and nothing else; choosing "Sign-in refused" sends `{"action":"login_failed"}` and lists only those rows, "All actions" removes the filter; an untoned action's badge carries `text-foreground` and no tone background while `create` keeps `bg-primary`; with no `sys_audit_log` served only "All actions" is offered.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`): exit 0, after `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2` (34 tasks successful). `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` lists every touched file, the two test files included.
- **Ablation (one-shot, not kept).** With the fix committed, the page's `actionFilterOptionsOf(auditObjectOf(objects))` was replaced by a two-item literal list through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `15c6161f5e25` to `305f1114db9a`). `AuditLogPage.actionFilter-13175.test.tsx` went red, 3 failed and 1 passed: `expected [ 'All actions', 'create', 'update' ] to deeply equal [ 'All actions', 'create', …(5) ]`, and `… to deeply equal [ 'All actions' ]` for the not-served case. The badge case stayed green, as expected: the badge does not read the option list. Restore proven: blob equal to `HEAD` (`15c6161f5e25`) and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Local gates (head `bf7e959`)

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, "5 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, "0 new citation(s)".
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: each exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the five touched source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors; the 2 warnings it prints (`no-explicit-any` on the fetch catch, `set-state-in-effect` on the load effect) are on lines this change does not touch.
- Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## For a browser read

The Action filter is the Radix select trigger (`role="combobox"`) in the filter card, beside the visible label "Action". It reads "All actions" until an action is chosen, and its items are `role="option"`. One locator: the `label` whose text is exactly `Action`, then the `combobox` inside its parent. On a stack running objectstack `main`, its options should be every declared `sys_audit_log.action` option, `login_failed` and `account_locked` included.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13175-audit-action-options.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/console`.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, none filed; carrier: none (承接者:无).

- The "All actions" item's value is the string `all`, which is also a valid system identifier. A server that declared an action named `all` would see it offered, but choosing it would read as no filter. No producer declares it.
- The row badge and the drawer badge show the stored value, not the declared label. Today every `sys_audit_log.action` label equals its value, so nothing differs on screen.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/HistoryTimeline.tsx` keeps its own badge tone map, with a comment saying its keys mirror the server enum. Its fallback for an unmapped action is already the neutral `outline`, so it hides nothing.
- The Action select has no accessible name: its visible "Action" label is not wired to the trigger, unlike the Object filter's.
- While object metadata loads, the Action filter shows only "All actions" with no loading hint, where the Object filter says "Loading objects…".
